english.meaning: to root for a team or cheer on a star
english.note: 捧邊隊 means which team do you support.

exampleSentences.english: Good thing I don’t support England.
exampleSentences.traditional: 好彩我唔係捧英格蘭嘅唧。

exampleSentences.english: I’ve always supported Germany, but this time I really can’t see how they could win the title.
exampleSentences.traditional: 不嬲都捧德國，但係今屆我真係諗唔到佢有乜嘢原因可以攞到冠軍。
